signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office

bullets: Own the vision and roadmap for Cardless's ledger, set priorities, and make the trade-offs needed to support the business as we scale.
Define how money movement is recorded, including authorizations, holds, settlements, reversals, refunds, disputes, fees, and payments across credit and debit.
Ensure the ledger is a trusted source of truth, with the controls and reconciliation needed to keep balances complete and accurate.
Make the ledger a shared foundation across products and partners, so we can add new products and money-movement types without rebuilding the underlying accounting logic.
